gate_1_coil_model_against_mag_manip.claim: the calibrated multipole's forward model gives mag_manip's field and gradient per unit current and its field, gradient, force and torque at drawn currents and moments, per system, within 10 eps / c of each quantity's peak (float64)
gate_1_coil_model_against_mag_manip.kind: bounds (a software oracle's agreement: it grounds neither sign nor frame against hardware)

prediction.basis: derived: the node's function, which test_calibrated_multipole holds to the same bound
prediction.why: the model is placed_unit_fields read from the node's leaves; the force and torque are products of its outputs

control.plant: none in this gate: the node test's planted errors (a sign, a frame) are test_calibrated_multipole's

gate_1_coil_model_against_mag_manip.if_wrong: the model reads the leaves otherwise than the node (a reshape, an order of sources)

gate_2_coil_model_against_actuation_in_b.claim: at a drawn placement, point, currents and moment, the model in each dtype against the host's actuation (float64) within 10 eps_dtype / c times the scale of the terms each quantity sums; OctoMag in float32 refused by its declared guard

prediction.why: two summations of the same near-cancelling sources agree to eps / c

control.plant: none: the placement's own control (the turn applied the other way) is test_calibrated_multipole's

gate_3_dipole_and_arm.claim: the point dipole's model against its closed form (64 eps of the field) and central differences of it (its gradient and its force within max(1e-8, 256 eps) of their scale), fixed and on the AR4's rotor; the kinematic arm's frames against frame_pose of its description, within 256 eps

gate_4_derivatives.claim: forward mode in u and in theta at once against central differences (h = 1e-6), float64, within 1e-5 of the derivative's scale, for the coils, the dipole and the arm

prediction.basis: derived: the differences' truncation (h / scale)^2 and rounding eps / h

gate_5_affine.claim: f(u) = f(0) + J u for every quantity of the coil model, the force and torque on a fixed moment included, within 64 eps of the terms' scale over the cancellation, in both dtypes

control.plant: the force read at the currents squared (u |u|)

gate_6_belief_equal_to_the_truth.claim: a belief equal to the truth gives the run of no belief bit for bit, every history array, in both dtypes; one number of it moved changes the writes

prediction.value: equal in both dtypes; the moved belief's writes differ
prediction.why: both build one program, its belief's numbers leaves of the controller's node of equal values

control.plant: the equal belief's array placed 1 nm off

gate_6_belief_equal_to_the_truth.cannot_discriminate_if: the step read no belief's number (then nothing would move): the moved arm of the same test fails that way

gate_7_the_allocation_follows_the_belief.claim: the true array 2 mm off, the belief where it was: the first tick's delivered currents equal the unmoved run's, and the field at the sphere is the belief's at the sphere's point less the move, to 1e-12

control.plant: the controller's models reading the truth whatever belief is declared

gate_8_the_allocator_is_the_hand_written.claim: on the R2 sphere ctx.allocator writes the hand-written allocation's currents bit for bit in float64 over 60 steps; in float32 its first tick within 1e3 eps32 x 25 A

prediction.value: equal; float32 first tick about 1e-5 A apart or less

gate_9_the_slew_box.claim: through a port slewing at 2 kA/s, for (controller, port) periods (3,1), (3,2), (2,3), (4,2), (5,3), (2,4) with latencies, the stage's slewed value reaches each target before the next arrives, within 64 eps64 x 25 A

prediction.basis: derived: _slew_steps is the least time between two changes of the stage's target per write

control.plant: the box as the controller's period alone
control.expected_rate: 20/20 on (3,2); caught on (3,2), (2,3), (5,3) in the test's planted arm, quiet where one period divides the other

gate_9_the_slew_box.cannot_discriminate_if: one period divides the other (the two rules agree): those configurations are not counted as the control's

gate_9b_the_slew_boxs_assumption.claim: the box last +/- slew * dt * g takes the stage to have stood at last. Where it did not, the allocation asks for more than the stage delivers and that shows: (a) from rest, the law's first last 0 A and the port resting at 10 A, the recorded traffic shows a shortfall above 1 A (written against delivered), and the control, the port resting at 0 A, none above 64 eps x 25 A; (b) after a glitch trips a port that trips at its bounds, the stage delivers its rest (0 A) while the law goes on asking for amperes (shortfall above 1 A) and the run raises tripped_currents (a UserWarning); the control, no glitch, is delivered to 1e-9 A and raises nothing. The build report says, beside each boxed command, that the stage is taken to stand at the last command. No flag is raised for a delivery the slew limited (disclosed, not added: a new public seam awaits the coordinator)
gate_9b_the_slew_boxs_assumption.kind: acceptance of a stated limit: it bounds nothing about the stage, it shows the box's assumption failing where it must

prediction.value: shortfall above 1 A where the assumption fails, at rounding where it holds; the trip flagged in the (b) arm alone
prediction.basis: measured-before (the laptop, float64): the trip arm asked [0.77, -24.7, 9.4] A and the stage delivered 0 A; the no-glitch arm asked and delivered alike
prediction.why: the stage ramps from its rest at the slew, 2 A a step, and the box's 6 A a write does not reach what is asked from 10 A in the writes between

control.plant: the box not there (the slew's steps infinite)
control.expected_rate: 20/20 on the from-rest control arm (the port resting at 0 A, which must hold the assumption)

gate_9b_the_slew_boxs_assumption.cannot_discriminate_if: the port rests where the law's last starts (the control arm: both agree); the test's rest-elsewhere arm is the one that discriminates

gate_10_refusals_keep_their_codes.claim: allocation.bounds, allocation.model, allocation.objective, allocation.exact-size (citing EXACT_COMMANDS) and controller.believed refuse what they name, each raised inside law(ctx) or in phase 1 with its own code; each control (the declaration made right) builds or plans; a law raising a plain error is still entry.defect

control.plant: MimeError not caught in law_and_models (as before AP3a): the bounds refusal becomes the entry's defect

gate_11_the_licence_gate.claim: a lab's conditional MPEM record nothing accepted is refused as asset.licence-not-accepted, its control (accepted) plans

control.plant: the calibration read around the gate (the cached file taken with no acceptance asked)
